explication: Versus Incident is a self-hosted incident-response product: incidents arrive from either the AI SRE agent or inbound webhooks, then share incident handling, notifications, templates, and on-call escalation. The dashboard supports incident response and agent administration, with additional service-health, topology, Kubernetes, chat, and runbook capabilities. The main evidence here is README documentation, the route setup, startup wiring, and selected agent and manager excerpts; links for unsampled subsystems are included only where documented, and some runtime details remain unverified.
